other_conditions: The girl must be born in Delhi as shown by the birth certificate issued by the Registrar (Births & Deaths), MCD/NDMC
The applicant must be a bonafide resident of the National Capital Territory of Delhi for at least three years preceding the date of birth of the girl child
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000
If the girl is school‑going, her school must be recognized by the Delhi Government/MCD/NDMC
The benefit is limited to two surviving girls per family
The application must be submitted within 90 days of admission for school‑going girls or within one year of birth for newborns
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to girl children in the form of term deposits of ₹11,000 (institutional delivery) or ₹10,000 (home delivery) at birth and ₹5,000 at key educational milestones up to Class 12.
documents_required: Birth certificate issued by the Registrar (Births & Deaths), MCD/NDMC
Duly filled and signed application form
